visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens outdoors at a ranch. A young girl with two braids wearing a bright red sweater and another toddler in a grey sweatshirt are standing next to a wooden fence with a chain-link mesh. A brown horse reaches its head over the fence. The girl in red holds out a piece of carrot, which the horse takes. (2) A close-up shows the toddler in the grey sweatshirt holding a carrot. She looks hesitant, pulling the carrot back and then offering it again. An adult's hand with a ring is visible, gently guiding her. (3) The scene transitions to a colorful carousel during the day. The toddler sits on a white decorated horse while a woman in a tan hoodie stands beside her, holding her steady. They wave toward the camera as the carousel rotates. (4) On a paved pathway, the girl in the red sweater walks forward. The camera then shows a brown and white horse inside a stable stall with a red metal door. The toddler, now being carried by a man wearing glasses, looks startled and starts to cry after the horse moves suddenly. (5) In the final segment, the toddler is seen feeding another horse and then clapping her hands. She is later shown looking intently at a slice of carrot in her hand, appearing to contemplate whether to eat it herself before the video ends on a pink graphic background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, fast-tempo acoustic guitar melody in a major key. A male voice with a bright, energetic tone introduces the location. Female voices are heard interacting with children, using high-pitched, encouraging prosody. (2) A distinct percussive sound (a horse sneeze/snort) occurs, followed immediately by the child's high-arousal gasp and whimper. The male voice reacts with a gentle laugh and rhythmic speech. (3) During the carousel scene, the BGM briefly includes a mechanical organ texture typical of carnival music, with a steady 3/4 waltz-like rhythm. The female voice asks the child questions with a melodic, rising intonation. (4) The track returns to the playful acoustic guitar BGM. Incidental sounds of the child's feet on pavement and the rustling of a plastic bag are audible. (5) The child's vocalizations shift from high-arousal crying back to calm, babbling speech. The audio ends with a bright digital 'ding' sound effect accompanying the final brand slogan.
